mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which is potentiated by phenelzine's potential to cause similar hematologic effects; additionally, phenelzine's MAOI properties may theoretically increase sympathomimetic sensitivity in hyperthyroid patients.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly; consider alternative antithyroid agent or antidepressant if possible; educate patient on signs of infection and agranulocytosis.
